## Change

Describe the behavior changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant offline tests, Ruff, formatting, and strict mypy pass.
- [ ] CLI/reference/example documentation matches changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, real Azure resource identifiers, or private input/output are included.
- [ ] Costs, compatibility changes, and remaining live-validation gaps are stated.

Live Azure testing is opt-in. Do not run billable tests without explicit authorization.
